mainEntity.name: What is a primary-residence tiny home?

acceptedAnswer.text: A primary-residence tiny home is a dwelling, typically 400 square feet or less, designed to be a homeowner's main place of abode. Unlike recreational vehicles or accessory dwelling units (ADUs), a primary tiny home often requires specific foundational connections and adherence to local residential building codes. It serves as a standalone home on its own plot of land or within a designated tiny home community, providing a complete living solution including kitchens, bathrooms, and sleeping areas.
